done: Tour complete — ? opens the Help panel; press it again to dismiss.

steps.prompt: Press ] to place the cursor on a node.
steps.after: The cursor is the highlighted node; the Inspector follows it.

steps.prompt: Press h to walk to an outgoing neighbour.
steps.after: h follows an edge leaving the node; the badge shows how many there are.

steps.prompt: Press l to walk to an incoming neighbour.
steps.after: l follows an edge pointing at the node.

steps.prompt: Press m a to mark this node as a.
steps.after: Marks are letters you can return to.
Every move is recorded in the jumplist.

steps.prompt: Press ' a to return to the mark.
Press Ctrl-o to go back through the jumplist.
Press z z to center the camera on the cursor.
steps.after: z t toggles whether the camera follows.

steps.prompt: Press ? to open the Help panel with every key.
